methods.signature: fn metadata(&self, id: &Id) -> Option<&'static Metadata<'static>> where S: for<'lookup> LookupSpan<'lookup>

items.name: Layer
items.signature: struct Layer<S, N = format::DefaultFields, E = format::Format<format::Full>, W = fn() -> io::Stdout>
items.summary: A [`Layer`] that logs formatted representations of `tracing` events.

methods.name: compact
methods.signature: fn compact(self) -> Layer<S, N, format::Format<format::Compact, T>, W> where N: for<'writer> FormatFields<'writer> + 'static
methods.summary: Sets the layer being built to use a [less verbose formatter][super::format::Compact].

methods.name: event_format
methods.signature: fn event_format<E2>(self, e: E2) -> Layer<S, N, E2, W> where E2: FormatEvent<S, N> + 'static
methods.summary: Sets the [event formatter][`FormatEvent`] that the layer being built will use to format events.

methods.name: flatten_event
methods.signature: fn flatten_event(self, flatten_event: bool) -> Layer<S, format::JsonFields, format::Format<format::Json, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets the JSON layer being built to flatten event metadata.

methods.name: fmt_fields
methods.signature: fn fmt_fields<N2>(self, fmt_fields: N2) -> Layer<S, N2, E, W> where N2: for<'writer> FormatFields<'writer> + 'static
methods.summary: Sets the field formatter that the layer being built will use to record fields.

methods.name: json
methods.signature: fn json(self) -> Layer<S, format::JsonFields, format::Format<format::Json, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets the layer being built to use a [JSON formatter][super::format::Json].

methods.name: log_internal_errors
methods.signature: fn log_internal_errors(self, log_internal_errors: bool) -> Self
methods.summary: Sets whether to write errors from [`FormatEvent`] to the writer. Defaults to true.

methods.name: map_event_format

methods.name: map_fmt_fields

methods.summary: Updates the field formatter by applying a function to the existing field formatter.

methods.summary: Updates the [`MakeWriter`] by applying a function to the existing [`MakeWriter`].

methods.signature: fn on_event(&self, event: &Event<'_>, ctx: Context<'_, S>)

methods.signature: fn on_exit(&self, id: &Id, ctx: Context<'_, S>)

methods.signature: fn on_new_span(&self, attrs: &Attributes<'_>, id: &Id, ctx: Context<'_, S>)

methods.name: pretty
methods.signature: fn pretty(self) -> Layer<S, format::Pretty, format::Format<format::Pretty, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets the layer being built to use an [excessively pretty, human-readable formatter](crate::fmt::format::Pretty).

methods.name: set_ansi
methods.signature: fn set_ansi(&mut self, ansi: bool)
methods.summary: Sets whether this layer should use ANSI terminal formatting escape codes (such as colors).

methods.name: set_span_events
methods.signature: fn set_span_events(&mut self, kind: FmtSpan)
methods.summary: Modifies how synthesized events are emitted at points in the [span lifecycle][lifecycle].

methods.name: with_ansi
methods.signature: fn with_ansi(self, ansi: bool) -> Self
methods.summary: Sets whether or not the formatter emits ANSI terminal escape codes for colors and other text formatting.

methods.name: with_ansi_sanitization
methods.signature: fn with_ansi_sanitization(self, ansi_sanitization: bool) -> Self
methods.summary: Sets whether ANSI control character sanitization is enabled.

methods.name: with_current_span
methods.signature: fn with_current_span(self, display_current_span: bool) -> Layer<S, format::JsonFields, format::Format<format::Json, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets whether or not the formatter will include the current span in formatted events.

methods.name: with_file
methods.signature: fn with_file(self, display_filename: bool) -> Layer<S, N, format::Format<L, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets whether or not an event's [source code file path][file] is displayed.

methods.name: with_level
methods.signature: fn with_level(self, display_level: bool) -> Layer<S, N, format::Format<L, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets whether or not an event's level is displayed.

methods.name: with_line_number
methods.signature: fn with_line_number(self, display_line_number: bool) -> Layer<S, N, format::Format<L, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets whether or not an event's [source code line number][line] is displayed.

methods.name: with_span_events
methods.signature: fn with_span_events(self, kind: FmtSpan) -> Self
methods.summary: Configures how synthesized events are emitted at points in the [span lifecycle][lifecycle].

methods.name: with_span_list
methods.signature: fn with_span_list(self, display_span_list: bool) -> Layer<S, format::JsonFields, format::Format<format::Json, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets whether or not the formatter will include a list (from root to leaf) of all currently entered spans in formatted events.

methods.name: with_target
methods.signature: fn with_target(self, display_target: bool) -> Layer<S, N, format::Format<L, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets whether or not an event's target is displayed.

methods.name: with_test_writer
methods.signature: fn with_test_writer(self) -> Layer<S, N, E, TestWriter>
methods.summary: Configures the layer to support [`libtest`'s output capturing][capturing] when used in unit tests.

methods.name: with_thread_ids
methods.signature: fn with_thread_ids(self, display_thread_ids: bool) -> Layer<S, N, format::Format<L, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets whether or not the [thread ID] of the current thread is displayed when formatting events.

methods.name: with_thread_names
methods.signature: fn with_thread_names(self, display_thread_names: bool) -> Layer<S, N, format::Format<L, T>, W>
methods.summary: Sets whether or not the [name] of the current thread is displayed when formatting events.

methods.name: with_timer
methods.signature: fn with_timer<T2>(self, timer: T2) -> Layer<S, N, format::Format<L, T2>, W>
methods.summary: Use the given [`timer`] for span and event timestamps.

methods.name: with_writer
methods.signature: fn with_writer<W2>(self, make_writer: W2) -> Layer<S, N, E, W2> where W2: for<'writer> MakeWriter<'writer> + 'static
methods.summary: Sets the [`MakeWriter`] that the layer being built will use to write events.

methods.name: without_time
methods.signature: fn without_time(self) -> Layer<S, N, format::Format<L, ()>, W>
methods.summary: Do not emit timestamps with spans and event.
